abilities.name: Harrowed Path

evidence.quote: If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains bonus movement speed and camouflage.

notes:
Spectral Maw recast does not incur the 1 second cooldown for regaining the stealth and instead prevents the stealth from being gained until the dash ends, resetting the cooldown if it is active.
  - The cooldown is not reset if it was incurred by basic attacking a large monster, but is however reset from it being incurred by Spectral Maw channel.
The bonus movement speed and camouflage are granted by the same buff, called Lord of the Mist.
Viego will enter camouflage even while Recalling.
The initial missile can be destroyed by projectile-blocking effects, but the formed Black Mist trail will not disappear. The wall spread missiles cannot be destroyed.

Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
  - The stealth regain timer is refreshed from basic attacks at the start of their attack windup.

abilities.name: Sovereign's Domination

evidence.quote: Does not destroy inbound projectiles from turrets, special cased to be targetable to turrets
Viego can basic attack a Mist Wraith to consume it: causing him to blink to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is untargetable (except to turrets) and unable to act.

states.note: Does not destroy inbound projectiles from turrets, special cased to be targetable to turrets

evidence.quote: He then gains Possession and heals himself for 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 0.4% per 100 bonus health) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) of the target's maximum health.

notes: Viego gains the bonus movement speed during possession even while moving towards nearby enemy champions that are untargetable.
The wind up's untargetability does not destroy in-flight projectiles from turrets.

Once possession ends, Viego returns to his normal state and certain effects gained from the possessed champion's abilities will be immediately removed.
  - Some buffs will be kept and some buffs will be lost.
    - Viego will almost always keep shields and spell shields.
    - Passive effects will be lost by default, as Viego no longer has their abilities.
  - Channeled and charged abilities maintained will be interrupted, and without granting any cancelation refunds to the respective slot (if applicable).
  - Toggled abilities will be automatically toggled off.
If Viego targets a Mist Wraith while already untargetable he will become targetable once again during the cast time.
If Viego possesses an enemy Fiora and the possession expires while performing Riposte, Spectral Maw will be placed on Riposte's cooldown.

abilities.name: Blade of the Ruined King

page.title: Template:Data Viego/Blade of the Ruined King

evidence.page: Template:Data Viego/Blade of the Ruined King
evidence.quote: He also heals himself for a portion of the post-mitigation damage dealt by the second strike: 100% against minions, 125% against monsters, and 150% against other targets.

notes:
Blade of the Ruined King deals:
  - Area damage for the thrust.
  - Basic damage for the second strike.
  - Proc damage for the on-hit bonus damage.
Ability damage that applies on-hit effects (e.g., R damage against the primary target) cannot apply the mark but can consume it, as a basic attack would.
Viego will not perform the second strike if the first attack was dodged, blocked, and missed.

abilities.name: Heartbreaker

evidence.quote: Other nearby enemies are knocked back up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
Upon arrival, he strikes the most wounded enemy champion nearby, dealing physical damage, slowing them by 99% for 0.25 seconds, and applying on-hit effects.
Active: Viego gains displacement immunity over the cast time, then blinks to the target location.

notes: Heartbreaker will cast at maximum range from the end of Spectral Maw dash if it is cast during the dash.
Heartbreaker's strike to the champion can be dodged and blocked, but not missed.
